questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: International study environment, different academic approaches, social interactions, culture exchange, exploring a different country.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: I think it was pretty straight forward as most of the useful informations were provided on the university sites.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Other than the introduction seminar i did not receive any assistance.

Additional comments

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was very difficult as there were many scam websites etc. General lack of transparency.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Be aware of scam sites and underlying costs

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It was straight forward. I just had to show up on a specific date and get a stamp etc.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Could receive help by either mail, phone or consultants.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Don't bother too much with course selection

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The level was low

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was very low but at the same time what I expected in Prague (eastern europe). The level was like highschool in some classes...

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: More oral, less analytic and fewer academic discussions

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
U.S. Foreign Policy during the Cold War
Critical Issues in U.S. - Chinese Relations
Populism and Democracy 
Geopolitics of Great Powers: Russia
Global Economic Governance (II)
Geopolitical Importance of Central Europe

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Populism and Democracy: was very interesting with a good lecture and a lot of discussion

questions.answer: Everything from different kinds of sports to debate and social groups

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Explore rural Czechia and visit other Eastern European countries.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: The countryside

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Very easy as it is a vibrant and international city

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: They have no inhibitions in relation to blowing their noses and coughing loudly in public situations. Also I found the waiters attitude etc. rude.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: I found the architecture nice and very interesting.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Make time for social activities, do not expect high or difficult academia, explore other places than Prague

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Plan your housing situation! Look primarily at the websites provided by the university. Avoid privat rental companies etc.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Social interactions

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The housing situation

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
